mapper.sql: id, name, description, nodes, edges, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_definition (id, name, description, nodes, edges, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{nodesJson}, #{edgesJson}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, NOW()))
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_definition SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, nodes = #{nodesJson}, edges = #{edgesJson}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_definition ORDER BY updated_at DESC
